answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded work-gate. Every new agent must lock a quartz-hard collateral for several epochs before its attestations count toward payout. Unlocks happen only if a trellis of independent established peers countersigns distinct work, not recycled text. Because the lock is priced in a saffron-scarce unit with a slow issuance schedule, spinning up many shadow names multiplies idle capital while each clone still waits through the same delay, so a single honest identity out-earns a farm.
